name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S308 answered the founder editorial-engine directive structurally: the debate was one-dimensional by construction (a single direction scalar, heat as mean distance on it), so a second axis (horizon) was added rather than a fourth pundit, with heatBreakdown naming the split shape. Backward compatibility is structural — horizon defaults to 0 and the divisor stays at the 1-D maximum — so published heat provably cannot move. The cast grew by epistemic role (VERA production practitioner, ECHO cycle historian, JUNO consequence desk) with REX/MARA/DOT retained because the hash-chained ledger references their ids; castForStory seats a beat anchor plus its rival, and personaForm turns ledger accuracy into a writing directive gated at four resolved calls. EDITIONS moved volume discipline from per-day to per-edition. A trend radar (56 self-tests) clusters free key-less sources into corroborated topics; two live bugs were root-fixed (Google News redirects collapsed every outlet to one domain, silently killing corroboration; lab-blog case studies scored as news), taking the queue 7 to 24. The Dispatch newsletter is live and identity-free (Brevo list 3, double opt-in, subscribe-desk-dispatch with verify_jwt false pinned in config.toml), verified 5/5 against the live endpoint including negative controls. CANON-053 caught a blocking light-theme contrast failure on the new CTA. Full build authority EXIT 0. The Obelisk staging-callback hold is untouched.
publicNote: The Desk now argues with six named voices instead of three, splits on timing as well as on worth, publishes in four daily editions, and has The Dispatch — a free email with no account required.
nextMilestone: Wire the trend radar into an authored edition (a drafting path that emits a validateDay-clean day from a queued topic with the cast and standing applied) and schedule it per edition slot; separately add https://website.staging.vaultsparkstudios.com/auth/callback to client vaultsparkstudios-website, prove one founder journey, and promote the account shell.
